Game Overview

At its heart, Teach Me Love is a adventure game about step into the shoes of a schoolgirl navigating love for the first time. Make choices, win hearts, and explore friendships as you balance the thrill of romance and the challenge of a bold bet. Can you discover the true meaning of love while deciding the fate of three classmates?
